text:
alina: quick follow-up to the gateway streaming/retry convo — proposing a lightweight commit/finality contract for hedged requests. uploaded a short note: https://go/repo/gateway-hedge-contracts

josh: nice. high level question: do we force a synchronous commit before any upstream applies side-effects, or allow optimistic apply + compensating action?

priya: we can't block every successful path on an extra roundtrip; tail-latency hit is real. recommendation: synchronous commit for strict side-effects (payments, DB-writes) and async commit for metrics/logging or noncritical ops. need a clear signal in the stream for clients.

oz: mechanically, what does the proxy need to do for streaming? once we hedge midstream the two upstreams may both emit chunks. we need a single canonical commit decision and a way to tell clients about provisional progress.

alina: draft contract in doc: - proxy adds X-Rw-Hedge-ID header when hedging - upstreams may emit provisional progress trailers: X-Rw-Prog: <byte-offset|token-count> - the service only applies irreversible side-effects after a /hedge/commit POST with body {hedge_id, client_idempotency_key}. if commit never arrives within TTL, service must not apply side-effects.

josh: require client-provided idempotency-key on initial request (Idempotency-Key). proxy ties hedge-id -> idempotency-key mapping. commit accepts either the client key or a signed commit token. that prevents duplicate commits on retries.

priya: client behavior suggestion: on receiving a streaming trailer with X-Rw-Finality: provisional, client should render progress but switch to conservative UI if finality unresolved after 2s. also call /hedge/status?hedge_id=... if it wants certainty.

oz: storage question: can proxy keep an in-memory snapshot per hedge-id to resume fallbacks without reprocessing full prompt? memory cost could explode. we should TTL aggressively and limit number of snapshots.

alina: config proposal (yaml):
```
edge.hedging:
  enabled: true
  hedge_snapshot_ttl_ms: 1200
  max_snapshots_total: 8000
  snapshot_memory_limit_mb: 512
  idempotency_backend: redis://dedupe-cluster
  commit_endpoint: https://internal/hedge/commit
  commit_sync_for_strict_effects: true
```

josh: operational rules: - if snapshot memory > threshold, degrade hedging to async-only or disable for low-tier tenants. - expose feature flag per-tenant to opt-out.

priya: observability: need per-hedge metrics: hedge.inflight, hedge.snapshot.size, hedge.commit.latency, hedge.commit.failures, hedge.fallbacks.emitted. instrument traces to connect client-visible stream chunks to hedge ids.

oz: security: commit endpoint must require either the original Idempotency-Key + tenant token or a signed witness from proxy. avoid exposing hedge ids to public logs.

infra-bot: docs:arch-proposals branch updated with gateway-hedge-contracts by alina at 2024-11-22T15:02:00Z :white_check_mark:

josh: edge-case: what happens if upstream applies side-effects before commit due to a buggy service? we should add a detection path: on commit-status mismatch, record incident, try compensating actions, and surface to tenant console. maybe add a best-effort atomic wristband: service returns X-Rw-Apply-Ok: true only after it has reserved resources and promises to require commit for finalization.

priya: another edge-case: client retries creating a new hedge-id with same Idempotency-Key while old commit still pending. lookup order on commit should be: 1) Idempotency-Key -> already committed? respond 200 idempotent 2) else accept commit for requested hedge-id.

alina: agreed. final items: - final RFC update to include explicit header names, trailer semantics, TTLs, metrics, and tenant toggles. - prototype a minimal proxy change to emit hedge id and attach trailer passthrough. - client docs with recommended UX for provisional progress.

oj: i'll volunteer to prototype the header/trailer passthrough in the proxy shim.

alina: thanks — please leave comments on the branch. i'll schedule a 30-min sync if folks want to walk the flow. :calendar:
